biggest_catch: You need $2,000 in direct deposits AND 25 debit card purchases of $5+ within 90 days, and NCU can claw back the bonus if you close the account within 12 months.
catches: $300 bonus requirements: promo code NEIGHBOR at opening; within 90 days of account opening, electronic direct deposit(s) of paycheck, pension, or government benefits (e.g., Social Security) from employer or government aggregating $2,000, plus 25 or more debit card transactions of $5 or greater.
PayPal, Venmo, and other similar payment service providers are not considered qualifying electronic direct deposits.
Must be 18 or older and an NCU member who has not had a consumer checking account opened within the last 6 months.
At bonus payment time the account must be open, in good standing, with a balance of at least $25.00; the bonus is deposited into the member's savings account within 120 days if all criteria are met.
NCU reserves the right to deduct the bonus amount if the account is closed within 12 months of opening.
Bonus cannot be combined with other offers; terms, fees, and benefits subject to change at any time.
Offer ends December 31, 2026 at 11:59 pm Central Time.

Membership is required - the official NCU page states eligibility if you live in the state of Texas (family members of Texans also qualify); no membership participation fee found in the official terms. General bank-bonus tax treatment applies — bonuses are generally taxable; NCU's captured terms do not state the reporting treatment.

steps: Read the official terms at https://www.myncu.com/bank/checking/cash-bonus and confirm you meet NCU's membership eligibility before opening (offer ends 2026-12-31 11:59pm CT).
Join Neighborhood Credit Union and open a new checking account using promo code NEIGHBOR (you must be 18+ and have had no NCU consumer checking account opened within the last 6 months).

Within 90 days of opening, have electronic direct deposits of your paycheck, pension, or government benefits from your employer or the government aggregating $2,000 post to the account (PayPal/Venmo do not qualify).
Make 25 or more debit card transactions of $5 or greater within the same 90-day window.

Keep the account open and in good standing with at least a $25.00 balance — the $300 bonus is deposited into your savings account within 120 days, and NCU can deduct it if the account is closed within 12 months.
timing: Bonus deposited into the member's savings account within 120 days if all criteria are met.
